subject: Pilot onboarding & accountability calendar — FinVista trial
messages:
From: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@finvista.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai; marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding & accountability calendar — FinVista trial

Thanks for the call this morning, Aisha. Quick recap from our side:

- We want a 4-week pilot focused on invoice categorization and routing accuracy (finance workflows).
- Key stakeholders: Jordan Reed (finops), Priya N (engineering lead), and procurement (contract).
- Must-haves: 80% top-1 categorization accuracy on our 10k sample, sub-200ms avg inference latency for single-item lookups, and end-to-end audit logs for every inference for 90 days.

Next steps from FinVista: please send the proposed week-by-week cadence and who from Redwood will own each checkpoint. Also include the evaluation rubric you mentioned. Procurement will start paperwork once we land on the timeline.

Jordan
VP, Finance Systems
FinVista
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@finvista.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai; marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 17:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding & accountability calendar — FinVista trial

Jordan — great to sync. Attaching a lightweight accountability calendar and the evaluation rubric (see attachments). High-level plan below; doc has owners, gates, and a sample scoring sheet.

High-level 4-week pilot (proposed):
- Week 0 (kickoff): Tech onboarding, dataset handoff (sFTP details), and baseline metrics. Owner: Marcus Lin (Solutions).
- Week 1: Model tuning with FinVista sample; daily short standups M-F. Owner: Monica Patel (Customer Success).
- Week 2: Integration validation (routing + webhook delivery), run closed-loop QA and retraining if needed. Owner: Marcus + FinVista eng.
- Week 3: Final acceptance tests, scorecard run, and readout. Owner: Aisha (you) + Jordan for signoff.

Success criteria (we recommend gating):
1) Top-1 categ. >= 80% on the official test set and no regression vs baseline for key categories.
2) End-to-end median latency <= 200ms for single-item queries under trial traffic profile.
3) Audit/logging completeness: all inference events retained and query IDs present for traceability.

Acceptance gates: if 2/3 success criteria met, run an extended 1-week focused iteration for outstanding items. If <=1/3 met, recommend pause and root-cause with rollback plan.

Attachments included: accountability calendar (.xlsx) and evaluation-rubric (.pdf).

Action items for FinVista:
- Confirm kickoff availability (we proposed Mon Jan 25, 10am PT).
- Provide sFTP credentials or a secure share for the 10k sample.
- Procurement to circulate redlines for the trial SOW.

I can update the calendar if Mon/Priya need different owners.

Thanks — looking forward.

— Aisha Rahman
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
From: Priya N <priya.n@finvista.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai; Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@finvista.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai; marcus_lin@redwood.ai; procurement@finvista.com
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding & accountability calendar — FinVista trial

Thanks — Monday 25th at 10am PT works for us for kickoff. A couple of clarifications from eng:

- For the latency target, is the 200ms measured at application-to-application (API call to Redwood) or end-to-end (including our in-app processing)? We need API-only numbers for internal SLAs.
- We will provide the sample via S3 link (credentials enclosed in separate secure email). Can Redwood confirm the expected CSV schema (fields + anonymization guidance)?

Procurement will push the SOW draft by Friday; they asked for the trial data retention period to be explicit in the SOW and whether logs will include raw input or only metadata.

Priya
Engineering Lead, FinVista
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Priya N <priya.n@finvista.com>; aisha_rahman@redwood.ai; Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@finvista.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai; procurement@finvista.com
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding & accountability calendar — FinVista trial

Priya — quick answers inline:

- Latency: we measure the 200ms target as API-to-response at our inference edge (API cold start excluded). We'll include a short load script during Week 1 to validate API-only latency under trial QPS (expected QPS ~ 1-2).
- CSV schema: see mini spec below (also added to the drive link): invoice_id, vendor_name, amount, date, ground_truth_label, submitter_id, redaction_flag; please hash PII columns or follow the anonymization notes in the spec.
- Logs: by default we retain inference metadata (request id, model version, token counts, timestamps, input hash). Raw free-text inputs are optional and require a signed data-handling addendum. We'll note both options in the SOW.

I've attached a preliminary test-run checklist to the accountability calendar. Marcus (Solutions) will lead the Week 0/1 tuning and provide daily standup notes in the shared Drive folder. Monica will own the weekly scorecard and acceptance test orchestration.

Looking forward to kickoff on Mon 1/25 at 10am PT. Join link: https://meet.redwood.com/finvista-kickoff

— Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@finvista.com>; Priya N <priya.n@finvista.com>

See you Monday. If anyone needs a different kickoff time, flag it today and we'll adjust.
